title: Here’s What to Know if You Plan to Travel During the Winter Storm
summary: Airlines have canceled more than 11,000 flights as a powerful storm brings ice, sleet and potentially major snowfall to the Midwest, South and Northeast.

title: Trump Praises UK Troops’ Sacrifice After Starmer Demands Apology
summary: Donald Trump lauded the UK’s military after Prime Minister Keir Starmer urged the US president to apologize for downplaying the role of NATO troops in the war in Afghanistan.
